distractors: Eager to take on additional responsibility, and saying so before anybody has offered it.
Easily talked out of a position you held, so that the last person to make a case tends to be the one who carries you.
Formally committed to a course of action, on the record and in a form other people will hold you to later. The question of willingness closed some time ago, which is the whole difference.

Able to be corrected or revised later without much cost, so that getting it wrong now turns out not to be expensive. It is a property of how easily a thing can be changed, said of the decision rather than of anybody making it.

Pleasant in manner but slow to act, agreeable in every conversation and reliably still exactly where you left them a fortnight later. The complaint is about the distance between how somebody sounds and what they actually do, which is a judgement rather than a state of being open to something.
